## What it is

Number 1, rendered blue. Back-left, 135°. Recessed 1. This tower carries the lowest hook, where the straight entry becomes the helix. The file name is the old on-axis angle.

## Design notes

- One piece. The hook is the tower. There is no separate clip and no joint between a clip and an arm.
- Print it on its side. The flat face is z = 0, rib and hooks together. The C is the layer outline, so the snap flexes in the layers.
- The neck is 6 mm wide. A 3 mm fillet sits on each side of it, in the layer plane, where the neck leaves the rib.
- The bore is the same grip as the earlier clip: 13 mm tube, 0.2 mm clearance, 2.4 mm wall, 11.5 mm mouth, 10 mm along the tube.
- Four hooks on the 965.2 mm tube: stations 0, 4, 8 and 12. The next one up would be past the cut end.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up. That puts the layer lines across the snap.
- Don't start the coil on a different tower. The other three are a quarter turn higher, each in turn.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: integrated hooks, side printed. Straight entry removed from the helix, so this tower still has four hooks and the old top hook on green is gone.
